verdict.rationale: iTerm2 documents shell integration that works "even over ssh," automatic profile switching when you ssh to a hostname, and SCP click-to-download. However, the docs say shell integration needs a login script installed on each remote host, with triggers as the fallback, so iTerm2 does not carry it along automatically. missing for 10: an SSH integration that carries shell integration automatically, terminfo propagation to remote hosts, carrying config/dotfiles to the remote, independent hands-on corroboration.
